tools.name: mri_list_categories
tools.title: List MRI categories
tools.description: List every Machine Relations Index category (e.g. cybersecurity, fintech, enterprise-software, ai-visibility-geo) with the question shapes that have published citation rates, plus the source-role vocabulary. Call this first to get a valid category key.

tools.name: mri_get_category
tools.title: Get an MRI category
tools.description: Return one category's question shapes (best tools, how buyers choose, comparisons, top lists, problem-first research, is it worth it, news) and the evidence state of each: published with rates, collecting, or not collectable.

category.description: Category key from mri_list_categories, e.g. cybersecurity.

tools.name: mri_get_cited_sources
tools.title: Which sources AI engines cite
tools.description: Ranked source domains that AI answer engines cite for one category and question shape, with citation rate (share of monitored answer runs citing the domain), rank, percentile and source role (editorial publication, vendor-owned, analyst research, community, academic/government, market database, wire distribution). Use to answer 'which publications/sources does ChatGPT or Perplexity cite for <category>' or 'where should a <category> brand earn coverage to be cited by AI'.

question_shape.description: Buyer question pattern: best_x (best X tools), how_choose (how to choose), is_x_worth (is it worth it), news_topic (recent news), problem_first (how to solve a problem), top_list (top platforms), x_vs_y (A vs B).

source_role.description: Optional filter, e.g. editorial_media for publications only, vendor_owned, analyst_research, community_social.

tools.name: mri_get_domain
tools.title: How often AI engines cite a site
tools.description: For one domain or URL, return how often AI answer engines cite it: overall citation rate, which engines cite it, confidence tier, rank among all cited domains and within its source role, and per-category segment rates. Use to answer 'does ChatGPT/Perplexity cite <site>' or 'how authoritative is <publication> as an AI source'.

domain.description: A domain (techcrunch.com) or any URL on it.

annotations.title: How often AI engines cite a site
